purpose: test whether target-prior intervention and target-feature corruption explain any apparent EQIR gain, using the same leak-free BioMaster folds rather than TAPB released headline splits

why_not_use_released_tapb_headline_as_th.cluster_execution: official main.py assigns target_test_with_id.csv to both validation and test, and Trainer selects the best epoch by validation AUROC
why_not_use_released_tapb_headline_as_th.davis_release: train-val/train-test/val-test contain 126/177/246 exact pair overlaps and 24/46/28 label-set conflicts
why_not_use_released_tapb_headline_as_th.source_overlap: the union of six released TAPB training files overlaps 1713 frozen BioMaster canonical pairs with 109 label-set conflicts; S5 contains 136 affected rows
why_not_use_released_tapb_headline_as_th.conclusion: released values are prior-art context, not same-data or independent-validation evidence

shared_protocol.inner_validation: the same deterministic grouped inner folds jointly respecting target homology cluster and drug scaffold group as EQIR
shared_protocol.fit_boundary: all train-derived target prototypes, priors, corruption statistics, model parameters and checkpoints are recomputed inside each frozen TRAIN/VALID boundary; held TEST is evaluated once
shared_protocol.selection_objective: equal-weight mean of inner-validation micro AUPRC, target-macro AUPRC and drug-macro AUPRC
selection_constraints: drug-macro must not be below the frozen query-balanced base
target-macro may be at most 0.002 below the frozen query-balanced base
no held-test labels may influence prototype construction, hyperparameters, checkpoint selection or calibration

frozen_inputs.drug: DTIAM_BERMOL768_FLOAT32_V1, frozen and projected by a trainable low-rank adapter
frozen_inputs.target: DTIAM_ESM2_T33_650M_1280_FLOAT32_V1, frozen and projected by a trainable low-rank adapter
frozen_inputs.nonstructural_reference: the fold-specific frozen DTIAM-BioMaster query-balanced base logit

train_only_target_prior_intervention.prototype_builder: KMeans over frozen ESM2 target embeddings from the current TRAIN boundary only
train_only_target_prior_intervention.prototype_prior: empirical TRAIN target assignment frequency normalized to sum one
train_only_target_prior_intervention.alignment: projected target query attends to train-only target prototypes; prototype-conditioned predictions are marginalized by the train-only prototype prior

target_feature_corruption.statistics: mutation scale is computed only from current TRAIN target embeddings

train_only_target_prior_intervention.important_boundary: this is a capacity-matched TAPB-inspired control, not an official TAPB reproduction and not a causal-effect estimate

required_variants.name: TAPB_INSPIRED_DIRECT_FROZEN_EMBEDDING_ADAPTER
required_variants.role: same encoder/adaptor capacity without target prototypes, prior marginalization or target corruption

required_variants.name: TAPB_INSPIRED_TRAIN_ONLY_TARGET_INTERVENTION
required_variants.role: full target-prototype alignment, train-only prior marginalization and target corruption control

required_variants.name: EQIR_FULL
required_variants.role: preregistered qualified-structure candidate, activated only after Stage0

capacity_and_training_fairness.interaction: elementwise product, absolute difference and scalar dot product after matched projections
capacity_and_training_fairness.head: two-layer SiLU MLP with LayerNorm and dropout 0.1
capacity_and_training_fairness.parameter_matching: select the smallest projection/head combination within plus or minus 10 percent of the active trainable parameter count of EQIR; report exact counts
capacity_and_training_fairness.same_batch_and_pair_sampling: match EQIR qualified-pair batch size and dual-query positive-negative sampling where applicable

mandatory_metrics_and_gates.minimum_support: at least 4 of 5 EQIR seeds improve held-test micro AUPRC versus each TAPB-inspired control, both cold-axis CI lower bounds exceed zero, target-macro is noninferior within -0.002, and drug-macro grouped CI lower bound exceeds zero
